title: Rdx
desc: Friends reunite after years to confront a rival gang's brutal attack.

title: Sadugudu Vandi
desc: Shiva's job hunt leads him to taxi driving, but his new gig gets haunted by eerie mysterious deaths. Can he drive through the chills and find answers?

title: Ayyanar
desc: Prabha, an idler, is always compared to his younger brother due to his careless attitude. But when his brother gets killed, he joins a criminal gang to find the people who murdered him.

desc: A poor Venu works at a roadside shop and loves Jyothi, who is employed in the adjoining apartment. Before Venu gets a chance to express his love to her, she meets with an accident and he is arrested.

desc: A Russian gangster wants to steal a magical stone with special properties to rule the world. Akhil is the only who can save the world by taking the magical stone and keeping it safe.

title: Tanga Manithan
desc: Balu, orphaned by his parents' untimely death, grows up without familial love. He embarks on a noble quest to ensure others like him receive the affection they lacked.

title: Maska
desc: A young millennial chasing their dream of becoming a movie star finds clarity in a summer romance, learning the difference between dreams and delusions.

desc: Jai, an undercover agent, works as a businessman to counter terrorism in India. When his cover is blown, he seeks his wife's help to capture a terrorist who has escaped from prison.

desc: A boy and a girl, who have run away from their respective homes for different reasons, meet and eventually fall in love. During their journey, they commit a number of crimes like burglary and fraud.

title: Manadhil Ninraval
desc: Aditya, an outgoing young man, falls in love with Varsha, an introvert. Varsha has feelings for him but is reluctant to profess them and they both part ways only to meet again after a few years.

title: Dharala Prabhu
desc: Prabhu agrees to become a sperm donor for a fertility clinic, leading to a significant change in his life.

title: Gentleman Sathya
desc: Sathyam and Chaitra meet unexpectedly and decide to only lie to each other. Soon, after they fall in love, Sathyam encounters Padmanabham, a criminal on the run from the Indian police.

title: M.C.A
desc: Nani saves his sister-in-law from a criminal in illegal business.

title: Virata Parvam
desc: Vennela, inspired by Naxal leader Ravi, defies societal norms and her family to pursue him amidst political turmoil, only to discover his disinterest in love.

title: Idhu Dhanda Police
desc: Ramakrishnan, police constable turned driver at Elathur women's police station, must navigate the fiery sub-inspector, Arundhathi Varma, to retain his job.

title: Rowdy Raja
desc: A young man suffers from kleptomania, which causes a lot of problems in his love life as his lover's father despises thieves.

title: Kirik Party
desc: Karna joins college and makes friends. He meets Saanvi, a senior, and events challenge his beliefs. The story shows their college life with humor.

title: Kaadu Nelam
desc: Despite his education failing to secure a job, a shepherd's son embraces his family trade. Through shepherding, he rediscovers himself and finds his true calling.
